title: Code for: Clinical Praat Parameters and Cepstral Representations for Speaker Independent Voice Pathology Detection: The Influence of Age and Dysphonia Severity (SVD revision)
description: Notebooks, Praat script and session-level tables for the revised version of manuscript JVOICE-D-26-01691 (Journal of Voice). Speaker-independent evaluation on the Saarbrücken Voice Database with control of age and dysphonia severity (AVQI v03.01).
